Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — Nebula (onboarding) just hit a ~3x spike in token burn after enabling their new semantic search. Need a short QBR-ready snapshot for Fri: burn drivers, 30d forecast, and concrete mitigation asks. Who can own the numbers?
Raj Patel: I can pull per-route token+latency breakdowns and model variant usage. ETA EOD today.
Ana Gomez: I’ll run a 30-day spend forecast with baseline / conservative / activation-surge scenarios. Need the raw usage CSV and any promo/retainer credits on file.
Kevin Ortiz: I’ll draft enablement steps for their engs — quick wins to cut embed token use (smaller context, batching, dedupe). Also schedule a 30m walkthrough if needed.
Maria Chen: Also capture feedback: they reported embeddings latency >300ms and errors during peak. Please tag product items.
Raj Patel: Quick query I ran locally to sanity-check routes:
```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM usage
WHERE account='nebula' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route;
```
Raj Patel: Raw check shows: embeddings_route ~82% of tokens, avg_latency 320ms; chat routes negligible.
Ana Gomez: Forecast summary (prelim):
- conservative: spend +20% next 30d
- baseline: spend +45% next 30d
- activation-surge: +140% (if cadence continues)
I’ll upload CSV + scenario sheet to the account doc.
Maria Chen: Proposed QBR asks / mitigations to present: 1) one-time retainer buffer (recommendation: ask for 3k credits to smooth activation), 2) soft rate-limit on high-volume routes, 3) enable quantized embedding model as fallback, 4) follow-up enablement walkthrough.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll add step-by-step for swapping to emb-quant model + example code snippet and sample batching logic for their SDK.
Raj Patel: Opening support ticket for config changes and we'll include a sample throttling policy: 
```json
{"max_tokens_per_minute":300000, "fallback_model":"emb-quant-v2", "monitoring":"alerts-on-5pct-spike"}
```
qbr-bot: Reminder — QBR deck drafts are due in #qbr-drafts by Thu 09:00 PST.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I’ll consolidate slides and assign owners. @Ana can you confirm the retainer ask number by EOD so I can include it in the deck?
Ana Gomez: Confirmed and uploaded the recommended retainer number + amortization breakdown. File: nebula_retainer_forecast.csv
Kevin Ortiz: :thumbsup: Scheduling walkthrough invite to Nebula devs for tomorrow 10:00 AM PST.
Raj Patel: FYI I’ll attach the route-level CSV to the support ticket and add a short runbook for fallback rules.
Maria Chen: Perfect — closing here, will ping if anything else pops up.
